name: bilibili-mcp
description: Bilibili (social): me, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_bilibili_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BILIBILI_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_bilibili_client_id.description: client_id of your Bilibili open-platform app (openhome.bilibili.com); also the x-bili-accesskeyid of every signed call.

platform_mcp_bilibili_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BILIBILI_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_bilibili_client_secret.description: The app secret (app_secret); signs every call (HMAC-SHA256) and is sent only to the refresh endpoint.

platform_mcp_bilibili_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BILIBILI_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_bilibili_refresh_token.description: The user's refresh_token from the OAuth2 code exchange (https://api.bilibili.com/x/account-oauth2/v1/token, scopes USER_INFO, ARC_BASE, ARC_DATA). Single-use: each refresh returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).

tools.name: me
tools.description: 获取用户公开信息 (scope USER_INFO): name, face, openid of the authorising user.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: 视频稿件删除 (scope ARC_BASE): irreversibly deletes one of the user's video submissions by resource_id (BV id).

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: 获取单个稿件数据 (scope ARC_DATA): view, danmaku, reply, favorite, coin, share, like, title and ptime of one video submission (BV id) the user authored or co-authored.
